caveats: A bare string argument with an embedded null byte truncates *on display* at the first `\0` (`printf` `"%s"`); the stored string is intact, and inside a container it renders as `'a\x00b'`. On Windows, the console is set to UTF-8 at startup (restored at exit), so non-ASCII output (`café`, CJK, emoji) renders correctly instead of OEM-code-page mojibake; redirected/piped output is unaffected either way ([ADR-00747](../adr/ADR-00747.md))
